Thirteen functions in `lib/` call `res.set`. I found them by searching `lib/` for `.set(` and `.header(` calls and matching each hit to the function around it. Calls to `this.set(...)` in `lib/application.js` are `app.set`, so they're left out.

**`lib/response.js`** (these all call `this.set`):
- `res.links`, line 94: sets `Link`.
- `res.send`, lines 175, 199, 206 and 223: sets `Content-Type`, `Content-Length` and `ETag`.
- `res.json`, line 276: sets `Content-Type`.
- `res.jsonp`, lines 320–332: sets `X-Content-Type-Options` and `Content-Type`.
- `res.contentType` / `res.type`, line 625: one function assigned to both names. I listed it as `contentType` because that's its declared name.
- `res.format`, line 699: sets `Content-Type`. The call is inside a nested callback, so it's credited to `format`.
- `res.attachment`, line 725: sets `Content-Disposition`.
- `res.append`, line 756: calls `this.set(field, value)`.
- `res.location`, line 924: sets `Location`.
- `res.redirect`, line 982: sets `Content-Length`.

**`lib/router/index.js`**:
- `sendOptionsResponse`, line 654: calls `res.set('Allow', body)`.

The call at line 798 is inside `res.set` itself, so it's excluded.
